BREAKING — United Independent School District police arrested David Sarli late Tuesday morning, October 20, 2026, on a FELONY charge of bringing a prohibited substance or item into a correctional facility, plus an assault charge, according to Webb County booking records.

Sarli was arrested at 11:33 a.m. and booked into the Webb County Jail (Booking #202608893) on two counts: (1) prohibited substance/item in a correctional facility (charge code PROH SUBSTANCE/ITEM IN CORRECTIONAL FACILITY), a THIRD-DEGREE FELONY under Texas law, with bond NOT set; and (2) assault causing bodily injury, a Class A misdemeanor, executed on warrant #2026015415, case #PFCC26-003309L1, with bond set at $5,000, cash or bail surety.

A third-degree felony in Texas is punishable by 2 to 10 years in prison and a fine of up to $10,000. A Class A misdemeanor is punishable by up to one year in jail and a fine of up to $4,000. The booking and court records reviewed by Webb Watch 956 do not describe the alleged incidents, and they do not state where they allegedly occurred; the arresting agency is the United ISD Police Department.

Webb Watch 956 will follow the case as it moves through the Webb County courts.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. David Sarli is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search (Booking #202608893, Oct. 20, 2026); Webb County public-access court records, Tyler Odyssey portal (Case #PFCC26-003309L1; Warrant #2026015415).

— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, News Anchors, Webb Watch 956
